name: Tonto National Monument
story: Tonto National Monument is located in the Superstition Mountains, in Gila County of central Arizona. It lies on the northeastern edge of the Sonoran Desert ecoregion, featuring well-preserved cliff dwellings occupied by the Salado culture during the 13th, 14th, and early 15th centuries.
matters: The area includes a lush riparian area supported by the Salt River and is surrounded by the Tonto National Forest, serving as a home for native animals and characteristic saguaro cacti.
